title: Finite free resolution of a coherent sheaf on a Noetherian affine neighbourhood
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme] [pqf-def-locnoeth], let $\mathcal F$ be a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent], and let $x\in X$. Then there are an affine open neighbourhood $U=\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ of $x$ with $A$ Noetherian, a finite $A$-module $M$, an isomorphism $\mathcal F|_U\cong\widetilde M$, and a bounded-above cochain complex $E^\bullet$ of finite-rank free $\mathcal O_U$-modules with a quasi-isomorphism $E^\bullet\to\mathcal F|_U[0]$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 01XZ (coherent-lemma-coherent-Noetherian), together with algebra.tex Lemma Tag 00LP (lemma-resolution-by-finite-free) and the affine tilde/Gamma equivalence (Tags 01IA, 01IB)

proof.text: Use coherence on the locally Noetherian scheme to obtain quasi-coherence and finite type. Choose a finite-type local generating family and an affine neighbourhood of x inside one member; transport its generators along the open immersion to obtain finite sections on the affine chart. The affine Noetherian component theorem gives the ring Noetherian and the tilde counit identifies the restriction with the tilde of its finite module of sections. The finite-section step uses the proved source-library theorem Scheme.Modules.finite_sections_top_of_isIso_fromTildeΓ, rather than the larger bundled affine finite-type criterion.

Apply the finite free resolution theorem to the finite module of sections, and apply the sheafification theorem to obtain the bounded-above finite-free complex and quasi-isomorphism. Transport the augmentation across the chart and over-site equivalences.

lean.statement: theorem coherent_affine_free_resolution (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] (F : X.Modules) (hF : RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace F) (x : X) : ∃ (U : X.Opens) (A : Type u) (_ : CommRing A) (_ : IsNoetherianRing A) (_ : x ∈ U) (_ : IsAffineOpen U) (M : Type u) (_ : AddCommGroup M) (_ : Module A M) (_ : Module.Finite A M) (e : U.toScheme ≅ Spec (CommRingCat.of A)), Nonempty (F.restrict U.ι ≅ (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor e.hom).obj (tilde (ModuleCat.of A M))) ∧ ∃ (E : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ), (∃ N : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, N < i → IsZero (E.X i)) ∧ (∀ i : ℤ, ∃ r : ℕ, Nonempty (E.X i ≅ SheafOfModules.free (R := (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U) (ULift.{u} (Fin r)))) ∧ ∃ q : E ⟶ (CochainComplex.singleFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U)) 0).obj (F.over U), QuasiIso q
